Extend circuit ~8 feet so chandelier can be centered in the building.

Run conductors in 3/4 metal conduit with metallic fittings for fire protection.
Provide and install listed ceiling box/support rated for 50 lbs (fixture is ~10 lbs).
Mount chandelier per manufacturers instructions.
Bond all metal components to equipment grounding conductor.
Test for continuity grounding and correct polarity.
Update panel schedule to reflect new fixture location.
